properties.headline: Red Flag Warning issued for the Bay Area
properties.description: Critical fire weather conditions expected in the East Bay Hills. Strong offshore winds and low humidity create extreme wildfire potential.
properties.instruction: Avoid all outdoor burning. Evacuate immediately if directed by local authorities.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning for southern San Francisco
properties.description: Heavy rainfall is producing flash flooding in low-lying areas. Move to higher ground immediately.
properties.instruction: Turn around, do not drown. Avoid flooded roadways.
